outcome: A search for cards matching an undefined quality finds nothing, so no card is moved by the effect.
A search for a quantity of cards moves exactly that many cards, or all the zone holds if fewer.
Cards found by a search that has no reveal instruction are not revealed, so no reveal event or reveal trigger occurs.
note: No record field marks a reveal.

outcome: When a search is replaced by a search of part of a zone, abilities that trigger on the library being searched still fire.

note: Searching outside the game needs a sideboard or wish pool, which collection games do not have.
